difficulty_bands.advanced: Expected learner difficulty from 0.60 through below 0.80.
difficulty_bands.core: Expected learner difficulty from 0.20 through below 0.40.
difficulty_bands.intermediate: Expected learner difficulty from 0.40 through below 0.60.
difficulty_bands.recondite: Expected learner difficulty at or above 0.94.
difficulty_bands.tail: Expected learner difficulty from 0.80 through below 0.94.

difficulty_target_scale: expected_learner_difficulty is a reviewed continuous 0.00-1.00 English-speaker German-learner difficulty target. It is presentation priority/proficiency level, not pure native rarity and not topic preference. Function words, compounds, transparent forms, and restricted-admission rows are flagged separately for admission policy.
